question: Identify the language which is primarily spoken in the state of Mizoram in India from the options below.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mizo**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Mizo** is the primary language spoken in Mizoram, a state in northeastern India.
 
• The Mizo language is a part of the Tibeto-Burman language family, widely spoken by the Mizos.
 
• Mizo is the official language of Mizoram and is used in government, education, and communication.
 
• The language is also known as Lushai or Duhlian, although "Mizo" is the preferred term.
 
• Mizo is written using the Roman script, which was introduced by Christian missionaries during the colonial period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mizoram:** Mizoram is one of the northeastern states of India, with Aizawl as its capital.
 
• **Mizo Culture:** The Mizo people have a rich cultural heritage with traditional dances like Cheraw and music playing a significant role.
 
• **Other Languages:** While Mizo is predominant, other languages such as Lai, Mara, and Chakma are also spoken in Mizoram.
 
• **Christian Missionaries:** Missionaries were instrumental in the spread of Christianity in Mizoram and contributed to the development of the Mizo script.
 
• **Mizo Literature:** Mizo literature primarily consists of folk songs, proverbs, and modern writings that reflect the culture and traditions of the Mizo people.
